# Fiji 2025: Value Added Tax (5111), two rates in 2025; excise not modelled

Sources: **Value Added Tax (Budget Amendment) Act 2025** (Act No. 10 of 2025, assented 21 July 2025; parliament.gov.fj
PDF, `cmp20/global/registry/ap_work/law/fj_act10_2025_vat_budget_amendment.txt`, sha256 in `law/SOURCES.tsv`):
s. 1 (2) "This Act comes into force on 1 August 2025"; s. 4 (a): section 14 (1) of the VAT Act 1991 amended by
"deleting “15%” and substituting “12.5%”" (s. 5: the same in s. 15 (1)). So supplies to 31 July 2025 bear 15 % and
from 1 August 2025 12.5 %. s. 9 adds payment services to Schedule 1 (exempt supplies), which lists financial
services. The principal Act's registration threshold and its zero-rated basic items were not read: no threshold is
applied and every basket good except financial services is taken at the standard rate.

Periods: a line may give `"date": "YYYY-MM-DD"` (the date of the purchases); without it the basket is spread evenly
over the year (212 days at 15 %, 153 days at 12.5 %).
extra_lean:
def vat1 : Vat :=
  { name := "Value Added Tax (to 31 July 2025)", standard := 1500,
    classOf := fun gd => match gd with
      | .financial => .exempt
      | _ => .standard }
def vat2 : Vat := { vat1 with name := "Value Added Tax (from 1 August 2025)", standard := 1250 }

def vatStatute1 : String := "VAT Act 1991 s. 14 (1) (15 %) to 31 July 2025"
def vatStatute2 : String := "VAT Act 1991 s. 14 (1) as amended by Act No. 10 of 2025 s. 4 (a) (12.5 % from 1 August 2025)"

/-- The purchase date given on the line, if any. -/
def dateOf (g : CanonGlobal) : Option String := g.str? "date"

def scale (xs : List Spend) (num den : Int) : List Spend := xs.map fun s => { s with amount := divR .down (s.amount * num) den }

def basketCharges (g : CanonGlobal) : List Charge :=
  if g.consumption.isEmpty then [] else
  match dateOf g with
  | some d => if d < "2025-08-01" then [vat1.basketCharge g.consumption vatStatute1] else [vat2.basketCharge g.consumption vatStatute2]
  | none => [vat1.basketCharge (scale g.consumption 212 365) (vatStatute1 ++ "; 212/365 of the basket"),
             vat2.basketCharge (scale g.consumption 153 365) (vatStatute2 ++ "; 153/365 of the basket")]

def businessCharges (g : CanonGlobal) : List Charge :=
  if g.entity == .company && !g.company.sales.isEmpty then
    (match dateOf g with
     | some d => if d < "2025-08-01" then [vat1.businessCharge g.company vatStatute1] else [vat2.businessCharge g.company vatStatute2]
     | none => [vat2.businessCharge g.company (vatStatute2 ++ " (no date given: the rate in force at the end of 2025)")])
  else []
notes: FJ 5111: VAT Act 1991 s. 14 (1) with Act No. 10 of 2025 (12.5 % from 1 August 2025)
unsupported: excise (Excise Act 1986 and the excise tariff): not read, not modelled
zero-rated and exempt items of the principal VAT Act (Schedules 1-2) other than financial services not read: standard rate applied
guards: (basketCharges { id := "x", household := { id := "x" }, consumption := [{ good := .food, amount := 36500 }] }).map (·.due) == [2765, 1700]

taxes.statute: VAT Act 1991 s. 14 (1), 15 (1); Value Added Tax (Budget Amendment) Act 2025 ss. 1 (2), 4, 5, 9
taxes.dated: Act No. 10 of 2025 (in force 1 August 2025): read; principal Act not read
unsupported: zero-rated basic items and other Schedule 1 exemptions of the principal Act
